snippet.description:
What does success really mean?

In this thought-provoking short, Karandeep Singh Sir, Director & Anthropology Optional Faculty at LevelUp IAS, shares his perspective on the definition of success, happiness and finding what you truly want to do.

Success is not only about achieving a particular career goal or sustaining yourself. It is also about taking time to introspect, discovering your passion, and asking yourself whether you are genuinely happy with the journey you are on.

For UPSC aspirants, the preparation journey can take years. Beyond ranks, marks and career goals, it is important to understand what you actually want from life and what makes the journey meaningful for you.

Watch Karandeep Singh Sir reflect on success, happiness, passion and the importance of introspection.
